reason: The method materially changed from identifier-only OS linkage to a concrete official-government title-boundary polygon payload. Planning Data reports HM Land Registry as the provider, marks the concrete entity as authoritative-source quality, and publishes its MULTIPOLYGON under OGL v3.0. However, the dataset explicitly describes these polygons as the position and indicative extent of a registered property, not a definitive canonical parcel boundary. The sampled title-boundary entity is also not target-bound to a verified BUILDING_PRESENT producer record. Therefore it is counted only as source-area evidence and not parcel progress; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
